containerDefinitions.name: espresso-node
entryPoint:
set -euo pipefail
proc=${BENCH_PROC_SYS:-/proc/sys}
IFS=';' read -ra wanted <<< "${BENCH_SYSCTLS:-}"
for pair in "${wanted[@]}"; do
  key=${pair%%=*}
  want=${pair#*=}
  got=$(<"$proc/${key//.//}")
  [ "$(echo $got)" = "$(echo $want)" ] || { echo "sysctl $key=$got, expected $want" >&2; exit 78; }
done
mkdir -p /efs/bench /efs/store /efs/payload /opt/bench
rm -rf /store /payload
ln -s /efs/store /store
ln -s /efs/payload /payload
ln -sf /efs/bench/genesis.toml /opt/bench/genesis.toml
stats=/efs/bench/task-stats.jsonl
(while curl -sf "$ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task/stats" | tr -d '\n' >> $stats; do
  echo >> $stats; sleep "$BENCH_SAMPLE_S"; done) &
touch /efs/bench/ready
go=/efs/bench/go
env_file=/efs/bench/node.env
until read -r at 2> /dev/null < "$go" && [ -n "$at" ]; do
  [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$BENCH_DEADLINE" ] || { echo "no go before the deadline" >&2; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.2
done
while IFS== read -r key value; do export "$key=$value"; done < "$env_file"
wait_ns=$((at - $(date +%s%N)))
[ "$wait_ns" -le 0 ] || sleep "$((wait_ns / 1000000000)).$(printf %09d $((wait_ns % 1000000000)))"
date +%s.%N > /efs/bench/started_at
exec > >(tee -a /efs/bench/espresso-node.log) 2>&1
exec timeout "$((BENCH_DEADLINE - $(date +%s)))" "$@"
